name: ListPlus agent API
description: Check contact records for errors (free), size markets (free), find people and leads, fill missing fields (paid per hit), and work on a workspace's lists. Every answer carries `options` (next steps with prices), `tell_your_user` and `account`. A paid action called with `estimate: true` answers its price and runs nothing. The manual: https://listplus.ai/a — a key: https://listplus.ai/app/agents
